Viborg is a Danish municipality whose healthcare data is tracked in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1]. Specifically, Viborg's data concerning stroke (apoplexy) events among patients with atrial fibrillation is utilized in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which evaluates the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant therapy [^src1]. 

The annual report breaks down clinical quality metrics across all 98 Danish municipalities to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the national healthcare system [^src1]. Viborg's specific statistical performance for these indicators is documented in a detailed comparative table on page 95 of the report [^src1]. Because the available data consists solely of this tabular mention, no further relationships, distinct claims, or historical timeline events are recorded for this entity in the current corpus.
